newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI maintains cut-off rate at 14-day auction.
newsitem.headline: India RBI maintains cut-off rate at 14-day auction.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Friday it maintained the cut-off rate at 99.81 rupees at its 14-day treasury bill auction.
Dealers said the yield was unchanged at 4.96 percent.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it accepted bids for 17.72 billion rupees at the auction of 14-day treasury bills on Friday.
The total face value of the bills issued was 17.72 billion rupees. The cut-off rate was steady at 99.81 rupees.
